data.turoyo: Madʕalla i barṯo du šex daš Šammar, məlla: "Ahlan w sahlan! B ʕayni maqbeli i miṯaytayḏəx l gabi w mʕazazto gfayšət gabi, hul d obəʕ lebəx!"
data.translation: Die Tochter des Scheichs der Schammar erwiederte:"Sei willkommen! Mit den Augen (von ganzem Herzen) nehme ich dein Herkommen zu mir an, und hochgeehrt wirst du bei mir bleiben, solange es dein Herz begehrt!"

summary: All four occurrences are feminine mʕazazto, matching II and the entry's Detransitive Part. Pass. No new finite form, sense or idiom is established.

The same honoured state functions as a vocative (29/63), a complement of gfayšət (29/67), an attributive epithet (29/71), and a past predicate in a relative clause (29/202). None asserts a newly performed honouring event.
The edition's sehr liebes Mädchen at 29/71 is preserved. The repeated hospitality context supports esteem/honour; it does not establish another love sense.

Existing references 29/67 and 29/202 are parallel uses attached to the vocative quotation, not proof that their wording is identical. The new 29/67 quotation exposes the different construction. 29/202 is not extended with unprovided verses.
